sm_trajectory S3 class

Source: R/trajectory-class.R
sm_trajectory.Rd

An sm_trajectory object encodes the career trajectory of a single author across a corpus, including career stages, topic pivots, collaborator turnover, emerging collaborators, h-index curve, novelty curve, and citation acceleration.

The object is created by sm_author_trajectory() and should not normally be constructed directly.

See also

Other trajectory: is_sm_trajectory(), sm_author_trajectory(), sm_plot_collab_turnover(), sm_plot_topic_pivots(), sm_plot_trajectory(), sm_researcher_profile()
